scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix sender install && npm --prefix receiver install
scripts.build: npm run build:sender && npm run build:receiver
scripts.dev: npx -y concurrently -n server,sender,receiver -c blue,green,magenta "npm run server" "npm --prefix sender run dev" "npm --prefix receiver run dev"
scripts.start: npm run install:all && npm run build && npm run server
